title: Pix infraction registration failure
description: Pix infraction integrity registration failure. The following endpoints generate this event: Create infraction report. For more information, see the Pix instant payments guide. Also see the Pix payments data events guide.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency key
idempotency_key.description: Key used to guarantee data Idempotency.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Reason for opening an infraction report.

situation_type.title: Situation type
situation_type.description: Situation that gave rise to the infraction notification. For notifications created in api v1, the value `UNKNOWN` appears.

details.title: Report Details
details.description: Details that may help the counterparty payment service provider (PSP) to analysis the infraction.

error_message.title: Error message.
error_message.description: Error message that occurred during processing in the integrity stream.
